subject: maths
question:
Study the following bar graph that shows the number of students enrolled for different courses in institutes A and B during 5 years, and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/487570190d3ea64ca165ae7867c66a4002ebe1ee73b44268554d2a5fb58d283e.png] 

The average number of students (per year) enrolled in A during 2015, 2016 and 2018 is what percentage less than the number of students enrolled in B during 2015 (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2015 = 280 

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2016 = 300

Number of students enrolled in institute A in year 2018 = 260 

Number of students enrolled in institute B in year 2015 = 360 

**Formula used:**

Average number of students for particular years = Sum of the students/No of years 

**Calculation:**

Average number of students in A during 2015, 2016 & 2018 = (280 + 300 + 260)/3

⇒ 840/3 = 280

Difference between the number of students enrolled in B during 2015 and average number of students in A during 2015, 2016 & 2018 = 360 - 280 

⇒ 80 

∴ The required percentage = 80/360 × 100 

**⇒ 22.2%**
